svg.text: Performed experimental precedent for generated complete reactions
Selected cases; complete net chemistry, not experimentally established electron-arrow sequences.
US7834039B2, General F: 3-chloroisonicotinic acid + SOCl2, room temperature20 h; concentrate/high vacuum1 h. Named acid-
chloride residue, no isolated yield or independent characterization. Repeated methyl heading conflicts with explicit
US7279470B2, Example193/General14: hydroxybenzophenone + N-methyl-N-phenylcarbamoyl chloride; DABCO/THF, room
temperature16 h, preparative HPLC. 36%, colorless oil; HPLC-MS332.2 and NMR. Benzophenone carbonyl retained.
US5650428, Example72/65: racemic serinamide507 mg + MsCl, pyridine, room temperature2 h;409.7 mg, mp95-97 C, NMR/MS471.
Primary CH2OH mesylated; sulfonamide/amide/ester retained. No percentage yield inferred.
Source/training overlap unknown; an experimentally documented transformation is not a tested whole route.
